verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's search page and `vastai search offers` (CLI/SDK) let an engineer query currently rentable offers before provisioning, filtering by GPU type, GPU count, verification and `rentable=true`, so stock is visible up front rather than discovered at launch. The evidence never documents filtering or viewing availability by region, and one user report of a host misrepresenting its location casts doubt on location accuracy. missing for 10: documented region/geolocation filter or availability-by-region view, explicit confirmation that listings reflect real-time capacity, independent hands-on corroboration of availability accuracy.
